answer: Require each identity to take rotating witness duty: it must audit a stranger's work and stake its own standing on the verdict. A whisper of collusion is caught because witnesses are assigned at random and their votes are checked against independent re-audits; matching errors across many identities reveal one shared operator, like rings in cedar wood tracing back to a single trunk. The attacker cannot forge cheap credibility: each fake identity must do real audit work and risk its stake, so a thousand puppets cost a thousand workloads, plus the whole cluster once correlation is exposed.
